output.sql:
SELECT c.company_name, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.company_name
LIMIT 5
output.explanation: This sums net revenue per customer for orders dated in 2025 that are flagged as revenue (is_revenue), then returns the top five. Shipping fees are not added. Ties are broken by company name.
